title: Midnight Bull Rider
description: A mysterious figure in a black cowboy outfit and studded hat rides a large black bull with glowing red eyes and silver horns along a blurred highway at night. The scene includes long-exposure light trails from vehicles, distant cattle, a cactus, tire tracks, and floating red rectangular shapes in the foreground.
prompt: A lone cowboy in a black sparkly suit and decorated wide-brim hat rides a massive black bull with glowing red eyes and large silver horns down a curving highway at night. Motion blur and light trails streak across the road, distant cattle stand in the darkness, purple smoke and red rectangular overlays float in the foreground near a cactus and tire tracks, dramatic cinematic lighting, moody western surrealism.
